Step 4: Dimensionality Reduction and Visualization, performing PCA dimensionality reduction using scanpy.tl.pca, constructing a KNN neighborhood graph with scanpy.pp.neighbors, output an AnnData object with dimension-reduced results; Step 5: Clustering Analysis, applying Leiden algorithm via scanpy.tl.leiden and UMAP/t-SNE visualization with scanpy.tl.umap based on dimension-reduced data, outputting cell cluster labels and visualization plots (.png);
